name: ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES_IIT
description: The Auth Entities IIT table contains the reference to the IIT record containing the identifier as it pertains to a single entity in the Auth Entities table.

columns.name: AUTH_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the auth bundle record.

columns.name: GROUP_LINE
columns.description: The line number of the associated entity in the auth bundle. Together with AUTH_BUNDLE_ID, this forms the foreign key to the ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES table.

columns.name: VALUE_LINE
columns.description: The line number of one of the multiple entity IIT record links associated with the auth bundle and the auth entitty from the ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES table.

columns.name: ENTITY_IDENT_IIT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the ID Type associated with the entity's ID value.

columns.name: ENTITY_IDENT_IIT_TYPE_ID_ID_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the ID Type.
